newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon investigates liquor store blasts.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon investigates liquor store blasts.

text.p: Security authorities are investigating a series of explosions in south Lebanon which damaged shops selling alcohol and video cassettes, security sources said on Monday.
They said they were investigating five explosions on Friday and Saturday which caused no casualties.
The blasts were in the port of Sidon and the town of Rmaile on the coastal highway from Sidon to Beirut.
